label: MYBL1::NFIB

sections.text: MYBL1 encodes a MYB-family transcription factor.
NFIB encodes a nuclear-factor-I transcription factor involved in tissue development.

The rearrangement alters MYB-family regulatory architecture and drives abnormal MYB-family transcription. MYBL1::NFIB is a recurrent fusion in adenoid cystic carcinoma; MYB- and MYBL1-driven tumors form related molecular groups.
